Forwarding Elena's asks. Draft legal guidance below (high level) — Monica, please confirm operational feasibility.

Markus' guidance (summary):
- Inspection notice: Redwood accepts a 30-day notice for routine SOC 2 inspections; for urgent or ad-hoc inspection requests, we require a minimum of 7 business days and reserve the right to limit scope to evidence handoff rather than live access.
- Pen test coordination: We will authorize customer-requested third-party pen tests subject to a signed order form appendix and a mutually agreeable 14-day testing window; customer must provide test plan and list of IPs/agents in advance.
- Evidence: Redwood will provide a standard evidence bundle (SOC 2 artifacts, configuration snapshots, audit logs) within 10 business days of written request; privileged access requests require a separate scoped agreement and additional controls (jumpbox, timeboxed credentials).
- Redlines: Prefer to keep detailed ops playbooks out of the MSA and attach as an Order Form appendix; accept a one-time commitment in order form for inspection cadence (e.g., annual SOC 2 or as-required).

Please see my suggested clause snippets in the attached PDF. If Elena is ok, we can propose final text and timeline by EOD.

-Markus
General Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: MSA + order form — audit access language and timeline

Elena — quick ops confirmation from my team: all three items below are feasible with the following constraints and timelines.

1) Notice windows
- SOC 2 inspection (document/evidence handoff): 30 business days preferred; we can accommodate 15 business days for customers with an annual cadence if scheduling allows.
- Live inspection access: 30 calendar days; for shorter notice we can provide evidence-only access.

2) Evidence bundles
- Standard bundle: control matrices, control evidence snapshots, configuration exports, and audit logs (redacted where necessary). Delivery target: within 10 business days after a formal request.

3) Pen test coordination
- We require a signed pen test appendix (order form) and a defined 14-day window. Customer must share the test plan and timeboxed IPs 5 business days before the window. Any interactive or privileged test (auth/break-glass) must be scheduled in staging and requires our approval.

Operational notes:
- We track evidence requests in a shared ticket (we'll include the Morgan & Co. POC on the ticket).
- If Clearwell wants a recurring annual inspection, we recommend specifying an "inspection month" in the order form to avoid conflicts.

I'll push the draft playbook with these constraints; Grace, tagging you to finalize redline language for the order form appendix.

Thanks,
Monica
Head of Assurance Operations, Redwood Inference
